description: Run an open model on one of the person's network computers (free) or on a community computer (paid in credits). The computer that runs it can read the request: use placement mine for private data. Tasks: image (prompt, count, size), upscale (file), stt (file: WAV), tts (text, voice), music (prompt, lyrics, seconds), vision (file + prompt), ocr (file), translate (text, targetLanguage), embed (text: string or list), rerank (query, documents). Files must be in a folder authorised in BitPull. Images and audio are saved as files and their paths returned. For plain chat use ask_open_model.

file.description: Absolute path of the input image (PNG/JPEG) or audio (WAV)

model.description: Model id from list_open_models; omitted = the most available one for the task

placement.description: auto (default): the person's own network computers first, for free, then the community. mine: never leaves the person's own computers; use it for private data.

waitMinutes.description: How long to wait; default: the person's setting, at least 30 minutes for images and music

name: use_open_model
